classification.difficultyReason: Combines exterior and reflex angles with quadrilateral angle sums and properties of special quadrilaterals.

content.prompt: Find the value represented by the pronumeral.

spec.description: Slanted quadrilateral with horizontal top and bottom edges and a dashed leftward bottom-edge extension.
spec.mathematics: The labelled interior angle 120° and exterior angle r° form a straight angle at the lower-left vertex.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 120° and unknown r° appear.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}r+120&=180\\r&=60\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $r=60^\circ$.

spec.description: Rectangle with four right-angle markers and a dashed rightward extension of the top edge.
spec.mathematics: Exterior angle b° is adjacent to the upper-right right angle.
spec.answerVisibility: The unknown b° appears without its answer.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}b+90&=180\\b&=90\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $b=90^\circ$.

spec.description: Quadrilateral with two left right angles, upper-right 115°, lower-right 65°, and a dashed top-edge extension.
spec.mathematics: Exterior d° is supplementary to 115°. Both right-angle markers and the redundant 65° remain.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}d+115&=180\\d&=65\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $d=65^\circ$.

spec.description: Concave arrowhead quadrilateral with 19° and 28° at the tips, a 124° non-interior angle at the inward vertex, and exterior z° at the upper-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: The concave interior angle is 360°−124°. The upper-right interior angle and z° are supplementary.
spec.answerVisibility: The 124° mark remains outside the concave interior; no solution labels appear.

answer.worked:
The reflex interior angle is $360^\circ-124^\circ=236^\circ$ (angles at a point). Let the upper-right interior angle be $t^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}t+19+236+28&=360\\t+283&=360\\t&=77\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line give
$$\begin{align*}z+77&=180\\z&=103\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $z=103^\circ$.

spec.description: Rhombus with one equality tick on every side, a 41° left interior angle, and exterior y° at the right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Opposite rhombus angles are equal; the right interior angle is supplementary to y°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and y° appear.

answer.worked:
All four sides are equal, so the quadrilateral is a rhombus. Opposite angles are equal, so the right interior angle is $41^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}y+41&=180\\y&=139\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $y=139^\circ$ (angles on a straight line).

spec.description: Kite with double ticks on the sides meeting at the lower-left vertex, single ticks on the sides meeting at the upper-right vertex, interior 81° and 117°, and exterior a°.
spec.mathematics: The unlabelled upper-left angle equals the lower-right 117° angle. The remaining interior angle follows from the quadrilateral sum.
spec.answerVisibility: No inferred angle values or supplied answer appear.

answer.worked:
The opposite angles between the unequal sides of a kite are equal, so the upper-left angle is $117^\circ$. Let the lower-left interior angle be $t^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}t+117+81+117&=360\\t+315&=360\\t&=45\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line give
$$\begin{align*}a+45&=180\\a&=135\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $a=135^\circ$.

spec.description: Parallelogram with double parallel marks on horizontal sides, single parallel marks on sloping sides, upper angles 49° and 131°, and exterior f° at the lower-left.
spec.mathematics: The lower-left interior angle equals the opposite 131° angle and is supplementary to f°.
spec.answerVisibility: Both given upper angles remain; no answer appears.

answer.worked:
Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal, so the lower-left interior angle is $131^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}f+131&=180\\f&=49\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $f=49^\circ$ (angles on a straight line).

spec.description: Irregular quadrilateral with reflex exterior arcs 281° and 292° at the upper vertices, a lower-right right-angle marker, and exterior x° at the lower-left.
spec.mathematics: The upper interior angles are 79° and 68°. The remaining interior angle follows from the quadrilateral sum and is supplementary to x°.
spec.answerVisibility: The source reflex angles, right-angle marker and x° appear without inferred values.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$, so the upper interior angles are $360^\circ-281^\circ=79^\circ$ and $360^\circ-292^\circ=68^\circ$. Let the lower-left interior angle be $t^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}t+79+68+90&=360\\t+237&=360\\t&=123\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line give
$$\begin{align*}x+123&=180\\x&=57\end{align*}$$
Therefore, $x=57^\circ$.
